variants.headline: Full shelves, empty household purses
variants.body: Food is for sale, but households cannot afford it and are going hungry beside full shelves. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Food for sale beyond the buyer's means
variants.body: Households are hungry despite available food because they do not have the money to buy it. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Hunger beside food that cannot be afforded
variants.body: There is food on the shelves, but people without enough money cannot obtain their meals. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.
